title: GarudaSDLC – Agentic Software Development Lifecycle Platform
summary: AI-native SDLC platform where autonomous agents convert meeting transcripts into structured workflows, enabling fully automated software delivery.
description: Architected an end-to-end agentic platform that transforms meeting transcripts into development workflows, issues, and tasks. Built a multi-agent orchestration system using LangGraph where project managers, reviewers, and expert agents autonomously write code, raise PRs, perform reviews, and iterate through CI/CD feedback loops. Designed transparent AI engineering integrating GitHub, Slack, and automated pipelines for human-in-the-loop governance and contextual issue memory.

title: AgentRise – Agentic Workflow Builder
summary: Drag-and-drop workflow builder enabling teams to define and execute AI agent workflows across multiple runtimes without code changes.
description: Co-developed a low-code agentic workflow platform with reusable components and role-based access control (RBAC). Enables teams to define workflows once and execute them seamlessly across Google ADK, LangGraph, and CrewAI runtimes. Integrated observability, authentication, long-term memory, and guardrails for secure agent execution.

title: PlatformAlpha – Agentic Code Transformation
summary: Enterprise platform enabling autonomous agents to perform large-scale code upgrades and framework migrations across repositories.
description: Built agentic applications enabling autonomous code upgrades (e.g., Angular to React, Java version upgrades) and framework migrations. Agents leverage structured filesystem access and advanced context pipelines for parallel, low-touch refactors at repository scale. Designed backend orchestration for file scheduling, safe write-back strategies, and context engineering for reliable autonomous code analysis and regeneration.
